summary: No evidence of installer-side threat in rdfxvela@2.0.1
details: The package contains only two scanned files and neither a static rule nor traced-code analysis surfaced any installer-side attack behavior — no lifecycle-hook shell execution, no environment/credential reads, no outbound network to attacker-controlled destinations, no dropper, no persistence, and no silent-relay of caller-supplied data.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
